lesson.title: Watch the wire
lesson.goal: Tap DeskA's port into Tap, send a ping to DeskB, and read the frames the sniffer captured.

step.text: Open OfficeSwitch and run show monitor session 1. No session is configured.
In config mode copy DeskA's port to the sniffer port: monitor session 1 source interface FastEthernet0/1 both, then monitor session 1 destination interface FastEthernet0/9.
Open Tap and look at Captured frames; the ping traffic appears even though Tap is not on the cable between the PCs.

check.label: Tap captured the ping through the mirrored port
